pg.kpi: The primary KPIs are M1, S0, and S1, which are different values within the 'Opportunity Stage' column. The KPIs are the count of opportunities and the total sum of 'Opportunity ACV'.
pg.attributes: The analysis should focus on slicing the data by 'Opportunity Type', 'Opportunity Owner Name', Opportunity Creator Name, Opportunity Creator Team,'Opportunity Owner Team', Opportunity Name.
pg.aggregations: The most important numbers are the count of opportunities and the total sum of 'Opportunity ACV'.
pg.goal: The goal is to understand how our early-stage pipeline is performing weekly across different teams. creators/owners and opportunity types, in order to identify high-performance areas and diagnose potential bottlenecks for targeted action.
pg.user_context: The analysis should be across each Opportunity Stage. Always treat each opportunity stage as a separate entity. I want the performance by Opportunity Team, Opportunity Owner and Opportunity Type for each Opportunity stage. Do this analysis for the last week. Then do the analysis for the last 8 weeks. Then compare them too. Output I need:1. Last week performance for each Opp stage across the important attributes 2. Last 8 weeks performance for each Opp stage across the important attributes 3. How my current week compares to the last 8 weeks. I treat each opportunity stage as a separate entity. Do not mix the data across stages. For M1, use Opportunity Creator Name instead of Opportunity Owner Name. For S0 and S1, use Opportunity Owner Name. ACV for each stage is a measure of the format M1 Starting ACV etc. Opportunity Region Segment should alwas be set to 'emea commercial' and 'emea enterprise'. Add this filter in all the data fetch as I am interested only in EMEA region and not any other region. NOTE: When analysing the individual Opprotunity Owner or Creator for each stage, I want to know the names and ACV of the top accounts/opportunities for each owner for each stage. Listing the names of the top accounts that made the owner perform well.
pg.report_format: The report should have 1. Executive summary that focuses on the last week and how it compares to the last to last week and the last 8 week average. 2. Detailed analysis of the last week across each Opp stage separately 3. How the last week compares to the last to last week 4. How last week compares to the last 8 weeks

Then do the analysis for the last to last week. Then do the analysis for the last 8 week average. Then compare them. The most important tab is "Customer Health" and the most important table in that is "NPS Comment Details". Output I need: 1) Last week performance for each NPS segment, primarily focusing on Detractors and Promoters across the important attributes 2) Last to last weeks performance for each NPS segment, primarily focusing on Detractors and Promoters across the important attributes 3) Last 8 week average performance for each NPS segment, primarily focusing on Detractors and Promoters across the important attributes 4) How my current week compares to the last 8 weeks

cmo.kpi: The primary KPIs M1, S0 and S1 quarterly. These are the values within the 'Creation Target Creation Metric' column. The measures are 1. 'Creation Achieved' - This gives the count of opportunities. 2.  'Creation ACV Achieved'- This gives the sum of the ACV of the opportunities. These 2 measures when combined with the 'Creation Target Creation Metric' will give the KPIs for each KPI. For each 'Creation Target Creation Metric', there are 2 KPIs. The target measures are 1. 'Creation ACV Target' - This gives the target ACV for each KPI. 2. 'Creation Target' - This gives the target count for each KPI. Apply 'Creation Target Opportunity Type' = existing customer expansion,'Creation Target Opportunity Type'=  new customer and [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode' for all KPIs without fail
cmo.attributes: Creation Target Region Segment, Creation Target Opportunity Type, Creation Target Opportunity Source
cmo.aggregations: ACV and Cunt and separate measures and hence no aggregation is needed
cmo.goal: The goal is to understand how the KPIs are trending towards the target. Which Geo, Source and Segment are lagging behind and needs attention
cmo.user_context: The analysis should be performed only on 'this quarter'. For each KPI, I want to know how it is trending towards the target. I want to treat the count and ACV of each of the 'Creation Target Creation Metric' as a separate entity while fetching data and analysing. THey need to be treated as separate KPIs. There is a formula to compute 'pts to pace' is a measure that gives a quantifiable number on how the KPI with the filters is trending towards the target with respect to the days in the quarter. Computation of points to pace : ' I want you to take the achieved number and divide it by the target number. multiply this result by 100. Have upto 1 decimal place.  Subtract this result and  74.7 (result_a - 74.7). This final number is the points to pace.'. This needs to be calculated once the data is fetched for each KPI across each attribute. This tells if we are ahead or behind the target with respect to the time progressed. I analyse first by Creation Target Region Segment (Geos). What are the Geos whose points to pace are the most negative. ALWAYS Within each Geos, I will look for the Source that are not performing well. Within the sources i will look for Opportunity Type. I ALWAYS look at the information in this hierarchy. Any other hierarchy should not be followed. This is a marketing funnel with each KPI being stages in a funnel. I want the analysis separatly for the count and ACV KPIs for each 'Creation Target Creation Metric'. In the Liveboard, the 'Creation to Targets' is the most important tab. It has pivot tables for each KPI across the important attributes as mentioned above. Critical: As you prepare the data fetch plan first and then run the analysis, you will not know which are the worst performing regions to get the Opportunity Source. Hence, get the opportunity Source for all the regions separately in the fetch plan. So that you can use it to analyse it. Do the same for Opportunity Type, as you will not know the worst performing Opportunity Source. Output I need: 1. Performance of each KPI as per the hierarchy mentioned for the target. Give as much information in terms of numbers as you have. Present all the relevant numbers in an easy to understand format. For each KPI, give me the analysis as per the hierarchy. In the analysis, mention the points to pace for each section of the analysis.  Very Important: THe Quarter starts in the month of August. To fetch data for this quarter, adding Creation Month = 'this quarter' to the prompt is enough, no need to mention the months
cmo.report_format: The report should have 1. Executive summary 2. Detailed analysis of M1 (Count and ACV) as per the hierarchy 3. Detailed analysis of S0 (Count and ACV) as per the hierarchy 4. Detailed analysis of S1 (Count and ACV) as per the hierarchy.

s.user_context: Sales operations managers and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly planning meetings to monitor pipeline generation performance by tracking M1, S0, and S1 stage opportunity creation counts and ACV values across different time periods, comparing individual contributor performance by creator name, owner, and source, analyzing team-level productivity across different creator profiles (SDR, AE, etc.) and opportunity types (new customer vs expansion), identifying trends in opportunity progression by examining stage distribution of deals created weeks ago, and drilling down into detailed deal lists to investigate specific opportunities that may need attention or follow-up action.

cmo_week_on_week.kpi:
ACV is obtained by measures - 'Opportunity M1 Starting ACV', 'Opportunity S0 Starting ACV'

Count is obtained by measure -  'f Opportunity M1 Created Count'

Apply 'Opportunity Type' = existing customer expansion, 'Opportunity Type'=  new customer and [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode' to all KPIs WITHOUT FAIL,
cmo_week_on_week.aggregations: The measures are separate for count and ACV.
cmo_week_on_week.date_column: Opportunity M1 Date, Opportunity S0 Date
cmo_week_on_week.goal: To track how the KPIs have changed since the last week to track how they are trending towards the target
cmo_week_on_week.user_context:
I NEED to know the KPI value on a cummulative basis from the start of this quarter on a weekly basis. This will help me understand how the KPIs are trending each week. 

So for example, take KPI M1 ACV

"Calculate the cumulative sum of Opportunity M1 Starting ACV by Opportunity M1 Date, restarting for each quarter. And then apply apply filter for weekly, and for 'this quarter', then you will get the ACV cummaltive for each week."

It should generate a formula 'cumulative_sum(Opportunity M1 Starting ACV,Opportunity M1 Date,quarter_number(Opportunity M1 Date)) ' and then it should apply filters for weekly and this quarter on the date column.

The above is designed to fetch the M1 ACV on a cummulative basis starting from the start of the quarter and then seen each week.

The above NL query prompt would fetch the required data.
This will give you what was the ACV for the quarter until last week and until this week. 
Subtract them to get the change in the previous week
Then in the report show the ACV until previous week, until this week, change, percentage change

In this way do it for all the KPIs. There are 3 KPIs in total (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV) by using the relevant measure and data name
cmo_week_on_week.report_format:
1. Executive summary
2, M1 ACV detailed report
3. M1 Count detailed report 

and so on

cmo_test.goal: Monitor sales pipeline performance and revenue achievement against quarterly targets to ensure business growth objectives are met.
cmo_test.user_context: CMO and marketing executives use this dashboard during quarterly business reviews and weekly leadership meetings to comprehensively assess marketing performance across the full customer acquisition funnel, starting with top-level quarterly bookings versus targets analysis through the pivot table breakdown by geography, opportunity source, segment, and deployment type, then drilling down into lead generation metrics by examining MQL creation trends and classifications to understand which marketing channels and campaigns are driving qualified leads, followed by pipeline progression analysis where they track conversion rates and stage duration from M1 through S7 to identify bottlenecks and optimize sales processes, while also monitoring trial user engagement and conversion metrics to evaluate product-led growth initiatives, and finally conducting pipeline coverage analysis to ensure adequate future quarter targets can be met, requiring them to ignore outlier data points in early-stage metrics that may not yet reflect true conversion patterns and focus on consistent quarter-over-quarter trends rather than month-to-month fluctuations when making strategic decisions about budget allocation and resource deployment.
cmo_test.report_format: Standard report format with executive summary and detailed analysis

tony_lb_a.goal: I want to know which Opportunities that are in the Sales cycle (Denoted by S, NOT M) stage do not have a Solution Engineer (SE) assigned
tony_lb_a.user_context:
Opportunity Stage = s1 discovery s2 pot s3 go/no-go with eb s4 validation s5 negotiate s6 ready to book
Opportunity Close Date = next 6 months

Opportunity Owner Team = emea, emea commercial, emea commercial roe, emea commercial uki, emea dach, emea dach commercial, emea dach enterprise, emea emerging enterprise, emea enterprise, emea france commercial, emea outbound, emea partner, emea sdr manager

Apply the above filters ALWAYS

What I want 
1. I want to know Opportunity Name that does not have have a SE assigned to it. Opportunity SE Name = '{null}' denotes that there is no SE assigned to that opportunity.
2. For these opportunities, I want to know if they are new accounts or expansion/upsell. For this I fetch the Opportunity Name, Account Name and [Opportunity SE Name] for Opportunity Stage = Closed DQ/Lost and S7 Closed Won. If I find a match, then it is expansion/upsell else it is a New Account
3. For Expansion/Upsell, I need to know who are the Opportunity SE Name who handled the original Account
4. For New Account, I need to know the bandwidth of my SEs.


So the end report should be
1. List of Expansions with the SE who handled the original account
2. List of new accounts 
3. Bandwidth information for all of the SE. Bandwidth is in terms of number of Accounts they are currently assigned to
tony_lb_a.report_format: Standard report format with executive summary and detailed analysis

t.goal: Track sales pipeline health by monitoring opportunity creation and progression across different stages (M1, S0, S1) to optimize revenue generation performance.
t.user_context: Sales managers and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly pipeline reviews to track opportunity creation velocity across different funnel stages (M1, S0, S1), analyzing both count and ACV metrics by individual contributors, teams, and lead sources to identify performance trends, compare team effectiveness, assess pipeline health progression from early-stage to qualified opportunities, and make data-driven decisions about resource allocation and coaching needs while focusing on non-closed-won deals from new customers and existing customer expansions.
t.report_format: Standard report format with executive summary and detailed analysis
